Dear Matteo,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Social Media Manager position at Trosort, as advertised. Your mission to end textile landfills deeply resonates with my drive to contribute to impactful projects.

My background in digital marketing, particularly with building and managing digital presence, content creation, and integrating social media for projects like mirook.com, directly aligns with your need for someone to launch and grow new channels. I am adept at creating engaging content and understanding how to drive visibility, skills I believe are crucial for generating B2B leads and raising awareness for Trosort's innovative sorting machine.

I am a highly autonomous individual, comfortable taking creative ownership and eager to apply my skills within your ambitious team. I am excited by the prospect of this portfolio-building opportunity.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

cover_letter:
Dear Trosort Team,

I am writing to convey my enthusiasm for the Social Media Manager position at Trosort, an opportunity that perfectly marries my digital marketing skills with a passion for impactful, sustainable innovation. The prospect of contributing to a quickly scaling startup dedicated to ending textile landfills is incredibly motivating, and I am particularly drawn to the complete freedom and autonomy offered to build and manage your social media presence from scratch.

My experience, particularly with my personal project mirook.com, demonstrates my capability to independently design, build, and integrate social media channels, alongside applying advanced SEO/GEO techniques to enhance digital visibility. This project involved full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook), showcasing my ability to take creative ownership and execute a digital strategy from conception to launch. At Episto, I consistently own on-page SEO and keyword-targeted content, effectively improving organic visibility and search rankings – a skill directly transferable to generating qualified B2B leads and awareness through engaging social content.

While the role emphasizes video editing, my background as a junior digital marketer has equipped me with a quick aptitude for new tools and platforms, alongside proficiency in content creation using tools like Canva. My understanding of driving organic traffic and visibility through SEO provides a strong foundation for creating lead-gen content and making Trosort’s automated sorting machine a recognized innovation in the industry. I thrive in autonomous environments, am a self-starter, and am eager to leverage my skills to put Trosort on the map across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and Shorts.

I am excited by this unique opportunity to contribute significantly to your mission and build a robust portfolio. Thank you for considering my application. I am available for a meeting at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
